I couldn't find anything about configuring the Django admin site in these FastAPI docs. The Django admin is part of Django, a separate web framework, so it isn't covered here.

For that, the best place to look is the **Django documentation**, specifically the section on "The Django admin site" (`django.contrib.admin`).

If you meant something on the FastAPI side, such as customizing FastAPI's built-in API docs UI (Swagger UI / ReDoc) or configuring app settings, I can help with that using these docs.
